label: Noise
description: How loud the party has been. At 3 the dead stir; at 6 a horde arrives.

3.text: The dead stir: distant moans and movement at the edge of the scene.

4.text: Nearby hordes turn toward the noise.

5.text: A horde is close; the next loud action may bring it.

6.text: A horde arrives, or the current horde grows.

label: Horde Pressure
description: The nearest horde's attention over days. At 6 it reaches the shelter or the current site.

3.text: The horde is drifting closer; more of the dead are on the roads.

5.text: The horde is near enough to hear; quiet and distance matter now.

6.text: The horde reaches the shelter or the current site.

label: Site Danger
description: How much trouble the current site has noticed the party. At 3 and 5 a complication arrives; at 6 the site turns on them.

3.text: A complication, omen, or threat arrives.

5.text: A second complication arrives; the site is fully alert.

6.text: The site turns on the party: a hard move, a collapse, or a swarm.

label: City Alert
description: How much the streets are watching. Crossings and loud work raise it. At 3 a patrol is out; at 5 a horde is drawn; at 6 the district sweeps.

1.text: A lookout on the next corner has seen the party move.

3.text: A patrol or runner pack is out on the street; crossing in the open now costs.

4.text: Roads close. Checkpoints, locked gates, and people who ask questions.

5.text: A horde is drawn toward the district; the next loud move brings it.

6.text: The district sweeps: a horde or an armed patrol fills the street. Get off it or go through.

label: Base Defense
description: How close an assault is to overrunning the shelter.

4.text: The perimeter is breached in one place.

6.text: The base is overrun; defenders must fall back or lose the shelter.

label: Chase Escape
description: At 6 on this clock the party gets away.

3.text: The pursuit is falling behind, but the road ahead is not clear.

label: Chase Pursuit
description: At 6 on this clock the party is caught, boxed in, or crashes.

3.text: The pursuit is closing; something on the road goes wrong.

6.text: The party is caught, boxed in, or crashes.
